title: App Studio 改版（1-4）：顶栏按钮搬家——保存/取消进详情页头，AI 助手和右侧栏开关进每页标题行右端；石墨色挂到整个 Studio
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: topic #37424 — parent decisions 3–4 and the maintainer's pick 「按推荐启动」 of phase 1 with the top-bar tenants' homes (2026-11-26 05:57Z, quoted on #37451). Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 1, P1-4).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 (takes the parent's grade) · evidence: the parent's decisions, mockups (#37424 comment 7181963746) and the current shell read on origin/main 7d50dc8b.
Reader: area `ux-37424` (seat `repo:objectstack#5`), an `os-dev` subagent or card thread after the blockers land.

Sequencing (2026-11-26T06:55Z): no longer waits for #37451 to merge — the homes this card implements are the maintainer's own pick on the area's decision card (quoted on #37451), and he set phase-1 UI as the priority (「优先还是第一阶段的界面美观度优化」, 2026-11-26T06:46Z). The graphite root mount consumes #37452's tokens: if #37452 has not merged when the rest is ready, merge main once after it lands.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：编辑一个对象、页面时，保存和取消在详情页头右侧；AI 助手按钮和右侧栏开关在每页标题行的最右边，和前端应用的页头一样。整个 Studio 用石墨色，不跟应用的主题色。
- 为什么：顶栏要去掉，这几样要先搬好家。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `StudioSaveControls` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~1541) → the item header's right-aligned action slot (`StudioItemHeader.tsx`).
- The AI assistant button and the right-slot toggle (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~1543–1570) → the right end of each page's title row (list title row and item header), following the front end's page header button group (#36107 / #36111).
- Mount the graphite accent defined by #37452 on the Studio root, so every Studio surface ignores the app's theme colour; only the app logo keeps it (decision 4).
- Read #37440 (publish without the draftVersion pin, names the Studio save bar) and #36660 (AI-draft notice on Save) first: they change the same save controls; sequence with them rather than collide.
- The top bar keeps its other tenants until P1-5 deletes it; ⛔ do not restyle it.

## Acceptance

- Save / Cancel, AI and the slot toggle work exactly as today from their new places (existing tests re-pointed, not weakened: e.g. the `saveBar-36511`, `copilotDoors`, `rightSlot` suites).
- A non-default app theme does not tint Studio (one test).

Governing text: `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md` as amended by #37451.
